title: Nicer to Drive Than Other Versions
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on comparisons between versions or generations, mainly describing the car as nicer to drive or ride in, while several snippets are too brief to determine a clear overall sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the car is more comfortable, nicer to drive, and quick enough while maintaining a small mpg gap versus another option.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets mention the car or a version being nicer to drive or ride, but the short comparative wording does not provide enough context to assign a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short comparative statements, so there is not enough context to determine clear sentiment beyond the single positive example.
The cluster mixes comparisons across versions, generations, and mild-hybrid references, so the exact comparison target is not always clear.
